why: '[Laughter]' inside Mr Deputy Speaker's paragraph was stored as his speech; it becomes its own row with no speaker, with the text before and after it kept as his.
title: Extension of a Sitting
html:
Mr Deputy Speaker: Order. Pursuant to Standing Order No 2(5)(d), I propose to extend the time of this day's Sitting beyond the moment of interruption for a period of up to 30 minutes. Mr Edwin Tong, you have another two minutes. If you are unlikely to finish within two minutes, then I will ask for an exemption of Standing Order 48 for you.

Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai: I thought you said five minutes.

Mr Deputy Speaker: Time is moving [Laughter]. Order. Minister Desmond Lee can apply for exemption.
